title: Picture-frame panelling round a living room
summary: Picture-frame panels in pine moulding, with a dado rail and shorter panels below, set out round a living room ready for painting.
intro: The same living room as the TV unit and bookcase. The walls were plain, and the room has a deep cornice and an old fireplace that deserved more than flat paint. Pine moulding went on as tall frames above a dado rail and shorter frames below it, spaced so they line up across each wall, round the door and over the radiator. Left ready for the decorator.

steps.title: Two profiles
steps.text: A wider moulding for the dado rail and a slimmer one for the frames, chosen first thing that morning.

image.alt: Two lengths of pine moulding held in a hand at the timber merchant

steps.title: Frames round the door
steps.text: Each frame is mitred at the corners and fixed to the wall. The frames by the door are sized so the gap to the architrave matches the gaps between panels.
